extracted.name: Tuna and rice savory, spicy warm salad
extracted.description: This dish came from just loving certain flavors/textures all together. Like a sushi roll without the nori. It was so good i forgot the nori and avocado in the picture lol and i have some. The only warm ingredient is the rice. Cucumber and avocado are cool. 😋 Japanese dishes use spicy mayonaise in so many awesome ways.
ingredient_lines: 1 cup cooked basmati rice or white rice
3 dashes chili sesame oil, or less. The more the spicier
Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds all over
instruction_lines: In a large bowl heat up leftover rice with butter until heated through.
Add mayo, tuna, chili oil, soy sauce and stir into rice.
Sprinkle the sesame seeds and red pepper flake on top of the rice. Salt/pepper if you like. Japanese rice seasoning makes it even better.
Peel and slice cucumber and avocado, drizzle italian dressing, and sprinkle with salt, pepper and sesame seeds.
If you want more or less anything with this recipe it works. I really hope you enjoy it as much as I did. 🤣😋
